chunks.text: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher. Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days and are stored in a hardware-backed key vault.
Alder & Finch Cloud Services holds a current SOC 2 Type II report and an ISO 27001 certification. Both are audited every year by an independent assessor and the reports are available on request.
Customer data is stored in Australian data centres in the Sydney and Melbourne regions. Backups stay in Australia and are retained for 35 days.
The production service is covered by a 99.95% monthly availability commitment. Planned maintenance happens outside business hours with 5 business days notice.
Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-128 and in transit with TLS 1.0. Encryption keys are rotated yearly.
We offer 99.5% availability for the production service. Maintenance windows are announced two days in advance.
Support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by phone and through the web portal.
Severity 1 incidents receive a response within 15 minutes. Severity 2 incidents receive a response within 1 hour and Severity 3 incidents within 1 business day.
Every customer has a named service delivery manager and a documented escalation path to an executive sponsor.
The platform supports single sign-on through Microsoft Entra ID using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect. Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all administrator accounts.
Access is controlled by role-based permissions with four built-in roles: Administrator, Author, Reviewer and Read-only. Customer administrators can define custom roles.
Implementation follows four phases: discovery, build, test and go-live, with a project governance meeting every fortnight. A typical onboarding takes 12 weeks from contract signature.
Each customer receives role-based training for administrators and end users, delivered online, and the recordings are provided afterwards.
The web application conforms to WCAG 2.1 level AA. An accessibility conformance report is provided on request.
For a regional retailer, the loyalty platform migration was completed in 14 weeks and reduced checkout page load time by 30%.
